audit.whatIsWrong: No win-rate figure is stated in the readable text.
audit.why: The real Emerald+ figure is 48.83% over 2617 games -- Yuumi is slightly behind.
audit.corrected: State Yuumi 48.83% WR vs Galio (2617 games).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side is a flat "Skill" template on every one of the 7 rows while content win[] already names Galio the whole way -- the full and content layers disagree on who wins every stage.
audit.why: Galio out-ranges Yuumi's detached poke with Winds of War from level 1, and Justice Punch + Shield of Durand start all-ins your shields can't answer once he hits his combo.
audit.corrected: Set all 7 phases[].side to "Galio" with a why grounded in his kit at that stage; win[] needs no edit since it already says Galio.

audit.why: Spikes already correctly flag level 2 (Q zone), level 6 (Hero's Entrance), first item (Q-E through shields), and late (global presence).

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the page states that Galio can cancel Final Chapter (R) with Shield of Durand or Hero's Entrance, or that Colossal Smash's auto-reset is the real burst tell -- both are in missingInteractions and unmentioned.
audit.why: Yuumi's R is a channel interruptible by any CC; Galio carries two sources (W taunt, R knockup). Colossal Smash is an auto-attack-reset passive, not a cast you can dodge by ability animation alone.
audit.corrected: tradeBad now names the channel-interrupt directly; dosFull[1] tells you to wait for both W and E to be down before channeling; dontsFull[2] explains the passive's real trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit anywhere ("matchup-defining" filler).
audit.why: The field exists specifically to hold real cooldown numbers.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Justice Punch 11-7s, Shield of Durand 18-14s, Hero's Entrance 180-140s.
